title: Must a product's check be kept from another product's data loaded in the same process?
description: The sealed engine keeps a check's query from files, web addresses, extensions and settings, but one engine serves every product a process loads. In a long-running process that holds two products at once (the app's server, the agent tools, the desktop app) a product's check can name another product's loaded data and read it, though never change it; the check of a repo loads its products one after another, so a gate that runs it is not exposed. Options: (a) accept it, as the products of one process share an owner and a repo; (b) one engine per product, which keeps each product's data apart at the cost of a schema copy and more memory per product; (c) a list of the loaded data sets a check may name, held by Lathe before the query runs, which a parse of the query can enforce but which is a second rule beside the engine's own.
